methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The assessment of maturity of an organization in the management of energy consumption according to the EMMM Model is obtained through 40 questions.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Maturity-assessment tool without an EnPI/EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: The Energy Management Maturity Model (EMMM) proposed here is meant to be accessible via web, enabling organizations to perform a self-evaluation in a fast, effective, and autonomous way.

stage1.notes: The paper scores organisational energy-management maturity; it does not present or characterise an EnPI/EnB measurement model.
